release_notes: SideKick now finds a client's GoCardless mandate the same way everywhere (email, then name, then shoot reference), and the 'Order Settled' check only counts money actually received. Bundles SideKick_GC v1.15.0.
changelog: NEW: One shared GoCardless client lookup used by SideKick_PS, SideKick_GC and SideKick_LB - it tries email, then name, then the shoot reference, so a partner's mandate paying the order is found
NEW: Settled-order acknowledgement on the GoCardless button - clients with no mandate whose album already covers the order total see their payment history instead of a prompt
NEW: SideKick_GC v1.15.0 bundled - bad-debt write-off workflow, AI Chat client-reply drafting with built-in humanise, GoCardless Release tag, and a faster-starting Client tab
NEW: Changelog button in Settings opens the formatted release notes in your browser
NEW: Searchable dropdowns across Settings
FIXED: 'Order Settled' no longer shown for unpaid orders - proposed Direct Debit lines and future-dated lines are no longer counted as money received
FIXED: Cancel plan now keeps instalments that were already collected
FIXED: Deferring or amending a plan no longer doubles the payment schedule
FIXED: Plans created silently now skip the plan-length ceiling, with the override recorded in the audit log
FIXED: A weekend start date moved by GoCardless no longer adds a duplicate first payment
FIXED: Cardly artwork upload no longer fails with a 403 error
FIXED: Saving a Stripe key can no longer wipe your other saved credentials
IMPROVED: Debug logs are now kept for 3 months

Previous (v3.1.11): v3.1.11 (2026-10-28): Charge-date fix in the GoCardless dialog, PayDay hides dates too soon for Direct Debit, Stripe payment QR slide, payment windows close reliably, bundles SideKick_GC v1.11.0
Previous (v3.1.9): v3.1.9 (2026-09-30): In-app Manual button and user manual shipped with the installer

Previous (v3.1.5): v3.1.5 (2026-09-25): One-click Quick Publish now bumps the patch version, rolls the changelog, tags the release and publishes it to GitHub automatically — no manual version edit or changelog step
Previous (v3.1.3): Fixes ProSelect's Add Payment / Review Orders windows sometimes staying open after a payment plan was written, blocking the album reload needed to show the new payment lines

Previous (v3.1.2): Fixes GHL reporting 'API Key Invalid' with a stale saved key, fixes log-upload 401 errors by moving all uploads to one verified Gist token, and shows the rejected key's fingerprint on failed permission tests
